parsed.explanation: Decriminalisation on paper is hollow: documented state practice substitutes morality/debauchery provisions to harass LGBT people (2024 report), and the state runs an active crackdown — coordinated suppression of gender/sexuality expression (2023), a 2023 cybercrime law enabling surveillance and prosecution, coerced closure of queer spaces, and officials smearing activists with doxxing that incites violence. Gender-affirming care is criminalised (up to 10 years) and no LGR pathway exists, signalling the state frames trans identity itself as unlawful. This is tier-2 state-tolerated targeting with no documented remedy. Most documented enforcement targets residents and activists rather than visitors, and no visitor arrests for presentation are recorded, keeping this slightly above the organised-sweep 0.15 anchors; but the surveillance environment, criminalised care, and demonstrated use of morality laws as a lever against gender expression mean an outed visitor faces serious exposure with no recourse. Extrapolating from these structural hostilities, ~0.22.
